Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the web result stating Defective by Design is a joint effort by the Free Software Foundation (FSF) and CivicActions, then incorrectly selected CivicActions as “the organization that founded” the campaign. The question targets the founder of the organization that founded DBD, which is the FSF; FSF was started by Richard Stallman (1985). This wrong inference led to pursuing CivicActions’ founders instead of Richard Stallman.
